description: This file defines an abstract class 'DittoDiagnosticLoggingAdapter' which extends logging capabilities for Akka framework by adding methods for setting and discarding correlation IDs and managing MDC entries, used for enhanced diagnostic logging in a distributed environment.

classes.name: DittoDiagnosticLoggingAdapter
classes.description: An abstract class extending Akka's DiagnosticLoggingAdapter with additional methods for correlation ID and MDC management, designed for thread-unsafe diagnostic logging enhancements.

methods.name: withCorrelationId
methods.description: Sets the correlation ID for the next log operation, either directly via CharSequence or derived from headers.

methods.name: setCorrelationId
methods.description: Sets the correlation ID globally until manually discarded, either directly or derived from headers.

methods.name: discardCorrelationId
methods.description: Removes the correlation ID from MDC for subsequent log operations.

methods.name: setMdcEntry
methods.description: Sets a key-value pair in the MDC for subsequent log entries.

methods.name: setMdcEntries
methods.description: Sets multiple key-value pairs in the MDC for subsequent log entries.

methods.name: discardMdcEntry
methods.description: Removes a specific MDC entry by key.
